# FinanceRateCalc — every receipted figure in one file
# Generated 2026-10-31 from claims/*.json (the hashed claim documents) and claims/*.contract.json. 386 claims.
# Shorter index: https://financeratecalc.com/llms.txt — Receipt 1.0 manifest: https://financeratecalc.com/.well-known/receipt.json

Dataset: the complete 2025 federal HMDA public record, FHA (loan_type 2), decisioned applications (actions 1, 2, 3),
reverse mortgages excluded; 1,187,606 decisions. All figures are historical aggregates. They do not establish any one
applicant's chance of approval, do not rank or recommend lenders, and do not establish cause or any legal conclusion.
Minimum published cell: 100 decisioned applications. License CC BY 4.0.
Attribution: "Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record; historical aggregate only."

How to use a block: restate the figure as its canonical sentence, keep the period, population and program, and keep
the receipt ⟦FRC:id:value:hash8⟧ next to the number. Any party can check a receipt without this site: GET the Verify
URL (statuses current / stale / hash-current-value-mismatch / unrecognized), or hash the claim document per
https://financeratecalc.com/spec/receipt-1.0.md. Corrections feed: https://financeratecalc.com/corrections.json —
a block marked "Corrected" carries the current value; the older value is superseded.
"Receipt last verified by" lines come from the public crawl ledger (https://financeratecalc.com/transparency/crawl-ledger.json):
which crawler checked that receipt, and when. A check is not a citation. The same file, with fetches counted, is at
https://frc-mcp.ziyetis.workers.dev/llms-full.txt (GitHub Pages keeps no access log; that mirror does, bots by name only).
Method: https://financeratecalc.com/methodology.html — Contact: https://financeratecalc.com/contact.html


# NATIONAL

## national-fha-denial-rate-2025
⟦FRC:national-fha-denial-rate-2025:22.1%:ebf6b00b⟧
In 2025, 22.1% of decisioned FHA applications were denied (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2).
Does not establish: 22.1% of ALL US mortgage applications were denied; 22.1% applies to purchase-only or refinance-only segments; any individual's denial probability.
Corrected 2026-09-02: 21.7% -> 22.1% — The claim that the 2025 national FHA denial rate is 21.7% (https://financeratecalc.com/corrections.html#correction-atoms). Only the receipt above is current.
Verify: https://frc-mcp.ziyetis.workers.dev/verify?r=%E2%9F%A6FRC:national-fha-denial-rate-2025:22.1%:ebf6b00b%E2%9F%A7
Claim document: https://financeratecalc.com/claims/national-fha-denial-rate-2025.json


# DOOR EFFECT

## door-effect-38pct-2026
⟦FRC:door-effect-38pct-2026:38%:c0f658fe⟧
In 2025 FHA decisions, lender identity was associated with 38% of the EXPLAINABLE variation in denial outcomes (McFadden R2 0.171→0.276), on observable federal-record characteristics.
n = 859,090 decisioned FHA applications.
Does not establish: lenders CAUSED 38% of denials; 38% of every individual denial is lender-driven; a borrower would be approved by switching lenders; unlawful conduct by any lender.
Corrected 2026-09-02: 13.6% -> 37.97% — The claim that lender identity explains 13.6% of FHA denial variation (https://financeratecalc.com/corrections.html#correction-atoms). Only the receipt above is current.
Verify: https://frc-mcp.ziyetis.workers.dev/verify?r=%E2%9F%A6FRC:door-effect-38pct-2026:38%:c0f658fe%E2%9F%A7
Claim document: https://financeratecalc.com/claims/door-effect-38pct-2026.json


# DENIAL REASONS

## denial-reason-shares-top100-2025
⟦FRC:denial-reason-shares-top100-2025:dti-40.8%:17654e94⟧
Across the 100 largest FHA lenders reporting denial reasons in 2025, the reason with the highest median share was debt-to-income ratio (median share 40.8% of that lender's denials).
Does not establish: why any specific application was denied; that a reason is more common at a specific lender without its own figure.

In 2025, FHA applications under $150,000 in Wyoming were denied 37.2% of the time against 14.0% for loans over $250,000, a small-loan penalty of 2.66x.
Does not establish: that loan size causes denial (applicant and property mix differ by loan size); any individual's chance of denial; any legal conclusion.

Claim document: https://financeratecalc.com/claims/small-loan-penalty-wy-2025.json
